abilities.name: Divine Marksmanship
_curatorNotes: N1 has two hitmarks (frames 17 and 27); N4 has two hitmarks (frames 15 and 28). One hits[] entry per notation step; swap/N sourced from the last hitmark of each (per recipe multi-hitmark rule).

N (ActionAttack) is not explicitly assigned in gcsim attackFrames[] for any hit — values are the second arg to InitNormalCancelSlice (AnimationLength / N-chain cancel). Recorded per Amber calibration convention.

plunge.go defines only highPlungeFrames (no lowPlungeFrames). High plunge is gated behind hold E: gcsim enforces 'last action must be hold skill' (Venti rides wind into the air after Hold E). plungeFrames sourced from highPlungeFrames. gcsim comment: 'TODO: missing counts for plunge cancels? using hitmark as placeholder' — all cancel keys equal AnimationLength = hitmark = 58; only swap recorded. No low plunge data exists for Venti.

abilities.name: Skyward Sonnet

variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: Hold variant cooldownStartDelay = 34 frames (vs Press = 21 on base skill). Schema gap: AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field — reviewer to extend schema or document. From skill.go: SetCDWithDelay(ActionSkill, 900, 34).

Hold E earliest cancel in gcsim is skillHoldFrames[action.ActionHighPlunge] = 116f (CanQueueAfter = 116). ActionHighPlunge is not a standard JSON key — not recorded in frames. After Hold E, Venti is airborne; typical follow-up is a high plunge (enforced by gcsim: high_plunge requires last action = hold skill with hold != 0).
All other action keys (N, Q, D, J) fall back to InitAbilSlice default = 289 (AnimationLength) — omitted per recipe rule.

'summon' tag inherited from generator. No summons[] authored: skill deals AoE anemo hit, and per A1 passive creates a 20s upcurrent on Hold — but gcsim does not model the upcurrent (asc.go explicitly: 'A1 is not implemented and will likely never be implemented'). Reviewer to decide whether to remove tag or author upcurrent as a summon/buff.
abilities.description:
O wind upon which all hymns and songs fly, bear these earth-walkers up into the sky!

Press
Summons a Wind Domain at the opponent's location, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching opponents into the air.

Hold
Summons an even larger Wind Domain with Venti as the epicenter, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching affected opponents into the air.
After unleashing the Hold version of this ability, Venti rides the wind into the air.

Opponents hit by Skyward Sonnet will fall to the ground slowly.

abilities.name: Wind's Grand Ode
_curatorNotes: Elemental Absorption: burst absorbs one of Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro once per use (absorb check begins at 4th anemo tick, frame 178; up to (480-24*4)/18 additional checks every 18f). Adds 15 absorbed-element ticks (24f interval) after absorption. Reviewer to decide effect-row representation.

Stormeye: 20 anemo ticks at frames 106, 130, ... 562 (106+24*i for i in 0..19); snapshot at frame 104. burstStart=94 is the constant used as spawnsAt — marks when the active window opens; first damage tick is at 106f. Duration 8s from gcsim comment ('8 second duration, tick every .4 second') and 20×24f = 480f = 8s.

Burst frames: InitAbilSlice(95) with comment '// Q -> N1/CA/E/D'. ActionJump=94 and ActionSwap=93 are explicitly set. ActionAttack, ActionSkill, ActionDash are NOT explicitly assigned (all default to AnimationLength=95f) — omitted per recipe rule. Reviewer may verify whether 95f should be recorded for those keys.
cooldownStartDelay: 81 frames from SetCDWithDelay(ActionBurst, 15*60, 81) in burst.go.
abilities.description:
Fires off an arrow made of countless coalesced winds, creating a huge Stormeye that sucks in opponents and deals continuous Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the Stormeye comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

passives.name: Embrace of Winds
passives.description: Holding Skyward Sonnet creates an upcurrent that lasts for 20s.

passives.name: Stormeye
_curatorNotes: Both effects have trigger: 'manual' inherited from generator. Probable trigger: end-of-burst (Stormeye expires). In gcsim: Tasks.Add(c.a4, 480+burstStart=574f from cast). Reviewer to replace manual trigger.

Second effect target 'self' is incorrect per description and gcsim: the second 15 energy goes to ALL party members whose element matches the absorbed element (for _, char := range c.Core.Player.Chars(); char.Base.Element == c.qAbsorb). Also gated on absorption having occurred (qAbsorb != NoElement). Reviewer to fix target and add absorption condition.
passives.description:
Regenerates 15 Energy for Venti after the effects of Wind's Grand Ode end.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, this also restores 15 Energy to all characters of that corresponding element in the party.

constellations.name: Splitting Gales
_curatorNotes: C1 fires 2 additional arrows on each Aimed Shot (both physical and fully-charged), each dealing 33% of the original arrow's DMG. Implemented in cons.go c1() as two extra QueueAttack calls at the same hitmark. No effect skeleton authored — needs reviewer pass.
constellations.description: Fires 2 additional arrows per Aimed Shot, each dealing 33% of the original arrow's DMG.

constellations.name: Breeze of Reminiscence
_curatorNotes: trigger: 'manual' inherited from generator. Probable trigger: onHit with ability: 'skill' — gcsim calls c2() as an AttackCBFunc on the skill hit (both Press and Hold variants). Applies to enemies struck by Skyward Sonnet.

Missing effect: physical resShred -12% for 10s. Only anemo resShred is currently authored. gcsim also applies AddResistMod(Physical, -0.12, 600f) — reviewer to add second resShred effect with element: 'physical' and duration: 10.

Airborne portion not modeled: gcsim comment 'TODO: the airborne part isn't implemented' — the additional -12% Anemo/Physical RES while opponents are airborne is absent. Reviewer to decide feasibility.
constellations.description:
Skyward Sonnet decreases opponents' Anemo RES and Physical RES by 12% for 10s.
Opponents launched by Skyward Sonnet suffer an additional 12% Anemo RES and Physical RES decrease while airborne.

constellations.name: Ode to Thousand Winds
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Wind's Grand Ode by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Hurricane of Freedom
_curatorNotes: trigger: 'manual' inherited from generator. Probable trigger: onParticleReceived while Venti is the active character. gcsim subscribes to event.OnParticleReceived with condition c.Core.Player.Active() == c.Index() — fires when ANY elemental orb/particle is caught by Venti on-field. Reviewer to replace manual trigger.
constellations.description: When Venti picks up an Elemental Orb or Particle, he receives a 25% Anemo DMG Bonus for 10s.

constellations.name: Concerto dal Cielo
constellations.description:

constellations.name: Storm of Defiance
_curatorNotes: trigger: 'manual' on both effects inherited from generator. Probable trigger: onHit with ability: 'burst' — gcsim calls c6() as AttackCBFunc on every burst anemo tick hit and absorbed-element tick hit. Duration 10s (600 frames, from modifier.NewBaseWithHitlag('venti-c6-...', 600)) is missing from both effect skeletons — reviewer to add duration: 10 to both.

Second effect (absorbed-element resShred -20%) is conditional on elemental absorption having occurred. The element is dynamic at runtime (Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro); no 'element' field on the second effect is intentionally correct. Reviewer to add absorption condition and duration: 10.
constellations.description:
Targets who take DMG from Wind's Grand Ode have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.
